## Business Overview

MacBook Repair Dubai (operating as Azizi Technologies) has been repairing Apple devices in Dubai since 10 October 2004. Located at Concord Tower in Dubai Media City, the workshop is a specialist independent repair center serving the entire UAE. The business handles every Apple product line - MacBook (Air, Pro, vintage), iMac (24" M-series and 27" 5K Intel), Mac mini, Mac Studio, Mac Pro, iPhone (every model from 6 through 17 Pro Max and 17e), iPad (base, Air, mini, Pro), Apple TV, and HomePod.

The business is operated by:
- **Shafiq Ahmad** - Senior Technician (since 2008, 18 years experience). Specializes in MacBook board-level repair, Flexgate cable replacement, liquid damage recovery, and Apple Silicon SoC diagnostics.
- **Usman** - Technician (since 2012, 14 years experience). Specializes in iPhone, iPad, customer diagnostics, and quality assurance.
- **Ali** - Technician (since 2011, 15 years experience). Specializes in mobile-device micro-soldering.

Combined hands-on experience exceeds 45 years. The shop is open Monday-Saturday, 9 AM to 10 PM Dubai time. Sunday closed in-store, but WhatsApp support continues.

## Services & Pricing (April 2026)

### MacBook Screen Repair

URL: https://macbook-repair-dubai.ae/macbook-screen-repair-dubai
Cost: AED 600-1,200  |  Timeline: 1-2 days

Display assembly replacement covering MacBook Air 13"/15", MacBook Pro 13"/14"/16" Intel and Apple Silicon, including Liquid Retina XDR mini-LED panels. We diagnose for free, replace the panel (or full lid where required), recalibrate True Tone, and re-test the FaceTime camera, ambient light sensor, and microphone array. OEM-equivalent panels are standard; genuine Apple panels available on request.

What's included: Panel, labor, 90-day warranty, free pickup/delivery in Dubai.

### MacBook Battery Replacement

URL: https://macbook-repair-dubai.ae/macbook-battery-replacement-dubai
Cost: AED 450-950  |  Timeline: 2-4 hours

Adhesive-bonded lithium-polymer cells removed safely with isopropyl alcohol release agents. We pair the new pack with the System Management Controller (SMC) so cycle count, design capacity, and condition report correctly in System Information. Genuine-grade cells with the same Wh rating as Apple OEM.

What's included: Battery, calibration cycle, 90-day warranty.

### MacBook Keyboard Replacement

URL: https://macbook-repair-dubai.ae/macbook-keyboard-repair-dubai
Cost: AED 350-950  |  Timeline: 1-2 days

For butterfly-keyboard MacBooks (2015-2019) we replace the entire top case (keyboard + battery + trackpad as one assembly). For Magic Keyboard MacBooks (2019+) we can replace individual keys or the full assembly. Apple Keyboard Service Programme eligibility is checked first - if you qualify, we send you to Apple for free service.

What's included: Top-case or key, battery (when bundled), trackpad, 90-day warranty.

### MacBook Logic Board Repair

URL: https://macbook-repair-dubai.ae/macbook-logic-board-repair-dubai
Cost: AED 800-2,500  |  Timeline: 3-7 days

Component-level board repair for short-circuits, blown ICs, no-power, GPU faults, USB-C controller failures, and post-liquid-damage corrosion. We diagnose with multimeter, thermal camera, and schematics, then reflow or replace failed components - far cheaper than Apple’s board-swap pricing.

What's included: Component(s), labor, 90-day warranty on the repaired fault.

### MacBook Water Damage Repair

URL: https://macbook-repair-dubai.ae/macbook-water-damage-repair-dubai
Cost: AED 700-2,000  |  Timeline: 3-5 days

Ultrasonic cleaning of the logic board, battery isolation, corrosion treatment, and component replacement where needed. Best results when brought in within 24 hours and not powered on. Coffee, juice, sea-water, and pool chlorine are the four scenarios we see weekly in Dubai.

What's included: Cleaning, replaced parts, data preservation attempt, 90-day warranty.

NVMe upgrades for Intel MacBooks (2013-2017 with proprietary connector, 2018-2020 T2 models read-only without Apple firmware). For Apple Silicon, storage is fused to the SoC; we recommend external Thunderbolt SSDs.

### MacBook RAM Upgrade

URL: https://macbook-repair-dubai.ae/macbook-ram-upgrade-dubai
Cost: AED 400-1,200  |  Timeline: 2-4 hours

Pre-2013 Intel MacBooks support socketed DDR3. 2013-2020 Intel MacBooks have soldered RAM (board-level upgrade possible on some models). Apple Silicon RAM is unified with the SoC and not upgradable - honest advice given.

What's included: RAM module(s), 90-day warranty.

## Apple Repair Programs (Free Service Eligibility)

Apple periodically offers free repair programs for specific defects. We always check your serial first - if you qualify, we send you to Apple at no charge.

### MacBook Flexgate (2016-2017 MacBook Pro 13"/15")
Display backlight cable wears at the hinge causing dark spots, "stage lighting" effect, or display failure. Apple’s extended program ended 2021. Out-of-program: AED 600 (cable) or AED 800-1,000 (full display) at our shop.

### MacBook Butterfly Keyboard (2015-2019)
Sticky, repeating, or unresponsive keys. Apple Keyboard Service Programme covered 4 years from purchase - most models now aged out. Out-of-program: AED 700-950 top-case replacement (keyboard + battery + trackpad).

### iPhone 7 Audio IC ("Loop Disease")
Greyed-out speaker button, no microphone in calls. Caused by motherboard flex breaking the audio IC pads. Apple never offered a program. We repair board-level for AED 350-500.

### iPhone 14 Plus Rear Camera (Active Program)
Some iPhone 14 Plus units have rear-camera issues with no preview. Apple offers free service through 2027. Bring your serial to Apple Genius Bar; we will not charge for diagnosis.

### iMac 21.5" Hard Drive (2012-2013)
Recalled drives. Apple program ended. We replace with SSD upgrade for AED 800-1,200.

## Frequently Asked Questions (Top 50)

### 1. How much does MacBook screen repair cost in Dubai?
MacBook screen repair at our Dubai Media City workshop costs between AED 600 and AED 1,200 depending on the model. MacBook Air 13" is AED 600, MacBook Air 15" is AED 700, MacBook Pro 13"/14" runs AED 700-1,000, and MacBook Pro 16" with mini-LED Liquid Retina XDR is AED 1,000-1,200. The price covers the panel, labor, True Tone recalibration, and a 90-day written warranty. Free pickup and delivery within Dubai is included. Most jobs are completed in 1-2 days; same-day service is available if the device arrives before 11 AM and the panel is in stock.

### 2. How long does MacBook battery replacement take?
A MacBook battery replacement is typically completed within 2-4 hours. The old adhesive-bonded cells are released with isopropyl alcohol, the new genuine-grade pack is fitted, and the System Management Controller (SMC) is paired so macOS reports correct cycle count and condition. We always run a calibration charge before returning the laptop. Same-day service is the norm; if you drop off before noon, you collect after 5 PM. Pricing ranges from AED 450 (older Air models) to AED 950 (16" Pro).

### 3. Do you offer same-day MacBook repair in Dubai?
Yes - same-day service is standard for screen, battery, keyboard top-case, trackpad, charging port, fan, and most software jobs, provided the device arrives before 11 AM and parts are in stock. Logic board, water damage, and data recovery typically need 2-7 days because they involve diagnostic time, component sourcing, or cleanroom work. We tell you upfront which category your repair falls into.

### 4. Where is MacBook Repair Dubai located?
We are at Office #45 on the 10th floor of Concord Tower, Al Sufouh, Dubai Media City, UAE. The building is on Sheikh Zayed Road service road, a 2-minute walk from the Nakheel Harbour & Tower metro link, and free parking is available in the tower basement. Coordinates: 25.0978° N, 55.1644° E. WhatsApp +971 55 741 3706 for live directions.

### 5. Do you provide free pickup and delivery?
Yes - free pickup and delivery is included for all repairs within Dubai. Our courier collects from your home, office, or hotel, brings the device to the workshop, and returns it once repaired and tested. Pickup slots are typically same-day if requested before 4 PM. For Sharjah and Abu Dhabi we charge a nominal courier fee or you can arrange your own delivery.

### 6. Are you an Apple Authorized Service Provider?
No - we are an independent Apple repair specialist. Apple has no authorized walk-in service provider in Dubai for out-of-warranty work; the Apple Stores in Dubai Mall and Mall of the Emirates send out-of-warranty repairs to overseas Apple Repair Centers, which takes 2-4 weeks. We are honest about this distinction. If your device is in warranty, AppleCare+, or eligible for an Apple repair program, we will tell you and recommend you go to Apple first.

### 7. What warranty do you offer on repairs?
Every repair carries a 90-day written warranty covering the part replaced and the workmanship. If the same fault recurs within 90 days we re-do the job at no charge. Software repairs carry a 30-day warranty. The warranty is invalidated only by accidental damage (drops, liquid) after collection or by third-party tampering.

### 8. Do you use genuine Apple parts?
We use OEM-equivalent parts as standard - these are made by the same Asian manufacturers Apple uses but sold outside the Apple supply chain. Genuine Apple parts are available on request for screen and battery; we quote the difference. For board-level components, capacitors, ICs, and connectors are sourced from the same suppliers (Texas Instruments, Cirrus Logic, Murata) used in Apple builds.

### 9. Will my data be safe during repair?
Yes. We never browse, copy, or transfer your data. We recommend a Time Machine or iCloud backup before any repair as standard precaution. For data-recovery jobs we sign a non-disclosure agreement on request. Logic board and water damage repairs preserve your storage in 95% of cases; we tell you upfront if the storage chip is at risk.

### 10. Do you fix water-damaged MacBooks?
Yes - water damage is one of our most-requested repairs. Bring the device in within 24 hours, do not power it on, do not put it in rice. We perform ultrasonic cleaning of the logic board, isolate the battery, treat corrosion, and replace any failed components. Coffee, juice, sea-water (worst case), and pool chlorine each need slightly different protocols. Cost is AED 700-2,000 depending on damage. Success rate is 85% if brought in early.

### 11. Can you repair MacBooks affected by Flexgate?
Yes - Flexgate (display backlight cable wear at the hinge on 2016-2017 MacBook Pro 13"/15") is a routine repair for us. Apple’s extended repair program for this issue ended in 2021. We replace the flex cable for AED 600 or the full display assembly for AED 800-1,000 if the panel is also damaged.

### 12. Can you repair butterfly keyboards on 2015-2019 MacBooks?
Yes. We first check whether your serial number is still eligible for the Apple Keyboard Service Programme - if it is, we send you to Apple for free service. Most affected models have aged out of the 4-year window now. Out-of-program, we replace the entire top case (keyboard + battery + trackpad as one assembly) for AED 700-950 depending on model, with a 90-day warranty.

### 13. How do I know if my MacBook battery needs replacing?
Open Apple menu > About This Mac > More Info > System Report > Power. Look at Cycle Count and Condition. If Condition shows "Service Recommended" or "Service Battery", or if Cycle Count is over 1,000, replacement is due. Symptoms: rapid drain, sudden shutdowns at 20-40%, or the trackpad rising (visible swelling - stop using immediately and bring it in).

### 14. Do you repair iPhones and iPads as well?
Yes - we are a full Apple device repair specialist. Despite the name, MacBook Repair Dubai handles iPhones (44 models from SE 1 to iPhone 17e), iPads (23 models), Mac mini, Mac Studio, Mac Pro, iMac, Apple TV, and HomePod.

### 15. How much does iPhone screen repair cost?
iPhone screen repair starts at AED 350 for older LCD models (iPhone 8, SE 2/3) and goes up to AED 1,400 for iPhone 17 Pro Max OLED. iPhone 11-13: AED 400-600. iPhone 14-15: AED 600-900. iPhone 16-17 Pro: AED 900-1,400. Genuine Apple displays cost more and are quoted on request. Most repairs take 30 minutes to 2 hours.

### 16. Can you replace iPhone back glass without buying a new housing?
Yes - we use laser glass removal which lifts the cracked back glass without disassembling the phone. This preserves the MagSafe magnet array, the wireless charging coil, and the waterproof seal. Cost: AED 400-900. Apple’s alternative is to replace the entire housing for AED 2,000+.

### 17. Will Face ID still work after iPhone screen replacement?
Yes - we transfer the original Face ID flex and dot projector to the new screen, so Face ID continues to work. The iOS message "Unable to verify this iPhone has a genuine Apple display" appears with all third-party screens (this is Apple’s anti-repair messaging, not a fault); the screen functions normally.

### 18. Do you repair iPhones with no Apple ID / activation locked?
No - we will not unlock or bypass iCloud activation lock on a device that may be stolen. We do help original owners who have lost passwords by liaising with Apple using proof of purchase. Bring your original receipt and ID and we will advise on the Apple recovery process.

### 19. Can you recover data from a MacBook that won’t turn on?
Often yes. For Intel MacBooks, the SSD can usually be read in another machine via Thunderbolt - recovery rate near 100% if the drive itself is healthy. For T2-chip Intel MacBooks (2018-2020) and Apple Silicon Macs, storage is paired to the logic board, so we must repair the board first. Our success rate is 70-80% for non-physically-damaged drives. AED 600-3,000 depending on complexity. No data, no charge.

### 20. Do you repair iPads with cracked screens?
Yes. iPad screen repair ranges from AED 350 (older non-laminated iPads, glass-only) to AED 2,500 (12.9" iPad Pro M4 with tandem-OLED). For laminated iPads (Pro, Air 4+, mini 6+) we replace the full LCD/OLED assembly. Pencil hover support is preserved on M2/M4 iPad Pro.

### 22. How much does iMac screen repair cost?
iMac screen repair runs AED 800 (24" M1/M3/M4 OLED) to AED 2,500 (27" 5K Intel 2017-2020 with True Tone). The job includes new adhesive strips for a clean reseal so the iMac looks factory after the repair.

### 23. Can you upgrade RAM or SSD on Apple Silicon Macs?
No - and we will not pretend otherwise. RAM is unified with the SoC on M1/M2/M3/M4/M5 chips and physically not upgradable. SSD storage is paired with the Secure Enclave; chip-level upgrades fail without Apple Configurator pairing. We recommend external Thunderbolt SSDs or trading up to a higher-spec Mac.

### 24. What payment methods do you accept?
Cash (AED), all major credit/debit cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Samsung Pay, bank transfer, and corporate invoicing for VAT-registered businesses. Payment is collected on completion, never in advance.

### 25. Do you offer corporate / fleet repair contracts?
Yes - we have ongoing service agreements with media companies, law firms, and design studios in Dubai Media City, JLT, DIFC, and Downtown. Volume discounts, quarterly invoicing, and on-site collection. WhatsApp +971 55 741 3706 to discuss.

### 26. Can you repair vintage MacBooks (pre-2015)?
Yes - we keep parts and tooling for MacBooks back to 2009 (white plastic Unibody). Vintage repair is one of our specialties; many repair shops refuse anything older than 5 years. Pricing is competitive because used parts are abundant.

### 27. What is your refund policy?
If we cannot fix the device, you pay nothing - "no fix, no fee" is core to our business. If a repair fails within the 90-day warranty period, we re-do it free of charge or refund the original repair cost. Diagnostics are always free.

### 28. Are you open on weekends?
We are open Monday to Saturday, 9 AM to 10 PM Dubai time. Sunday is closed in-store, but WhatsApp message responses continue 24/7 (slower on Sunday). Public holidays vary - check WhatsApp.

### 29. Do you repair MacBooks for delivery to Abu Dhabi or Sharjah?
Yes - UAE-wide service. Dubai pickup/delivery is free. Sharjah and Abu Dhabi: nominal courier fee or self-arrange (Aramex, Talabat). Most cross-emirate repairs are turned around in 2-4 days.

### 30. Will an unauthorized repair void my AppleCare+?
Yes - if you have AppleCare+ and the device is in coverage, use it. AppleCare+ accidental damage service is AED 99-399 (screen) or AED 379-1,099 (other), making it cheaper than out-of-pocket Apple replacement and on par with our pricing for premium models. We will tell you when AppleCare+ is the better choice.

### 31. Do you fix MacBooks under Apple’s vintage / obsolete lists?
Yes - Apple stops servicing devices 5 years after discontinuation (vintage) or 7 years (obsolete). We continue to service these. MacBook Air Intel 2017, MacBook Pro 2015 Retina, iPhone 7/8, and earlier are routine for us.

### 32. How do I book a repair?
Three options: (1) WhatsApp +971 55 741 3706 with a photo and description - fastest, you get a quote in minutes; (2) call +971 55 741 3706; (3) walk into Office #45, 10th Floor, Concord Tower, Dubai Media City. No appointment needed for diagnostics; we recommend WhatsApp first to confirm part availability for your model.

### 33. Do you repair MacBooks bought from outside the UAE?
Yes - origin of purchase makes no difference to us. US, EU, KSA, India, Singapore, Hong Kong models all have the same internals; we have parts for all regional variants.

### 34. Can you replace the trackpad on a MacBook?
Yes - Force Touch trackpad replacement is AED 350-700 depending on model. Common after spills (liquid kills the haptic engine quickly) or drops. We recalibrate the Taptic Engine after fitting.

### 35. How fast can you replace a charging port?
USB-C / MagSafe charging port replacement on a MacBook is a same-day job - 4-8 hours for the board-level soldering. iPhone Lightning/USB-C ports take 45 minutes. iPad ports take 1 day.

### 36. Do you sell used MacBooks or trade-ins?
Yes - we accept trade-ins toward repairs and we sell refurbished MacBooks with our 90-day warranty. WhatsApp for current stock.

### 37. Can you reinstall macOS or upgrade to the latest version?
Yes - clean macOS install, version upgrades (where Apple still signs the firmware), and downgrades (where IPSW is signed) are AED 150-250. Includes Time Machine restore if you bring the backup drive.

### 38. Do you offer Boot Camp / Windows installation on MacBooks?
Yes for Intel MacBooks (Boot Camp Assistant). Apple Silicon MacBooks cannot run Boot Camp natively - we install Parallels Desktop or VMware Fusion with Windows 11 ARM. AED 250-400 including license advice.

### 39. How do I know if my MacBook needs repair or replacement?
Free diagnostic answers this. Our rule of thumb: if repair cost exceeds 60% of the device’s second-hand market value, replacement makes more sense. We tell you honestly - losing one repair is better than losing a customer.

### 40. Do you repair MacBooks with swollen batteries?
Yes - and you should bring it in immediately. A swollen battery pushes the trackpad upward and can puncture, releasing flammable electrolyte. Do not charge it. We safely remove and replace for AED 450-950.

### 41. Can you fix a MacBook that won’t turn on at all?
Yes. Free diagnostic identifies whether it is the battery, the charger, the SMC, the logic board, or the SSD. Common easy fix: SMC reset (free). Power IC failure on logic board: AED 600-1,200. Liquid damage: AED 700-2,000.

### 42. Do you keep parts in stock or order them?
Common parts (current MacBook batteries, screens for popular models, iPhone 11-17 screens, common iPad screens) are in stock. Less common parts (vintage Mac panels, specific GPU chips) are ordered and arrive in 1-4 days.

### 43. Are diagnostics really free?
Yes. We diagnose without charge because (a) most diagnostics take 15-30 minutes, (b) we want to earn your trust before earning your money, and (c) we have been operating this way since 2004. There is no "diagnostic fee" hidden anywhere.

### 44. How does WhatsApp quote work?
Send a clear photo of the device, photos of any damage (cracked screen, water exposure, etc.), and the model name (Apple menu > About This Mac for laptops; Settings > General > About for iOS). We reply with a price range and timeline within 30 minutes during business hours.

### 45. Do you protect customer data during data recovery?
Yes - strict NDA available, data is recovered to a customer-supplied drive only, recovered files are wiped from our equipment at handover. Data recovery is the most trust-sensitive job we do; we treat it accordingly.

### 46. Are your technicians certified?
Our senior technician Shafiq Ahmad has 18 years of MacBook board-level experience (since 2008). Usman (since 2012) specializes in iPhone and iPad. Ali (since 2011) handles mobile devices. Combined hands-on experience exceeds 45 years. We are experience-certified rather than vendor-certified - Apple does not offer board-level certification to independent shops.

### 47. Why are you cheaper than the Apple Store?
Apple Stores quote board replacement (entire logic board swapped for a refurbished one). We do component-level repair - replacing the failed capacitor, IC, or connector for a fraction of the cost. We also do not carry Apple’s retail overhead, marketing budget, or Tier-1 service center fees.

### 48. How can I trust an independent repair shop?
Three honest signals: (1) 215+ verified five-star Google reviews over many years; (2) 21+ years operating from the same address (Concord Tower since 2004); (3) free diagnostic and "no fix, no fee" - we have nothing to hide. WhatsApp us, ask any question, judge for yourself before committing.

## Common Apple Issues We Repair (Technical Detail)

### MacBook Flexgate
The Flexgate issue affects MacBook Pro 13" and 15" models from 2016-2017. The display data/backlight flex cable is routed across the hinge mechanism and wears through after thousands of open/close cycles. Symptoms progress from a faint "stage lighting" pattern at the bottom of the display, to vertical bands, to complete backlight failure. Apple’s repair program ended in 2021. We replace the cable for AED 600 in 1-2 days, or the full display assembly for AED 800-1,000 if the panel itself is also damaged. The repair includes a longer cable to prevent recurrence.

### MacBook Butterfly Keyboard
Apple’s low-profile butterfly mechanism (used 2015-2019 MacBook, 2016-2019 MacBook Pro, 2018-2019 MacBook Air) is prone to dust and debris ingress, causing sticky keys, repeated characters, or non-responsive keys. Apple ran a 4-year repair program; most affected machines have now aged out. Out-of-program, the only fix is a full top-case replacement (keyboard, battery, and trackpad as one bonded assembly) for AED 700-950 at our shop. Apple charges AED 1,800-2,500 for the same job.

### MacBook Liquid Damage
Coffee, juice, and water spills are weekly visitors. The CPU rail (PPBUS_G3H) and USB-C charge controllers are the most commonly killed circuits. Salt-water exposure (Gulf swims) is the worst case - corrosion is rapid and continues even after drying. Best practice: power off immediately, do not put it in rice (urban myth), bring to us within 24 hours. We perform ultrasonic cleaning of the logic board in a Branson 5800 with isopropyl-alcohol solution, treat corrosion with circuit-grade flux, and replace failed components. Success rate 85% if early; 50% if powered on after exposure.

### iPhone Audio IC Failure (iPhone 7 / 7 Plus)
Known as "loop disease". The motherboard flexes around the audio IC during normal use, eventually breaking the BGA pads. Symptoms: greyed-out speaker button during calls, Voice Memos crash, Siri does not respond, no microphone audio. We re-ball or replace the audio IC under microscope for AED 350-500.

### MacBook Pro 2016-2019 Discrete GPU (AMD Radeon Pro 5xxx)
Years of thermal stress on BGA solder joints can cause GPU failures - black screen, distorted graphics, kernel panics on graphics-intensive tasks. We reflow or replace the GPU for AED 800-1,800. Re-paste with PTM7950 phase-change material reduces recurrence.

### iMac 27" 5K Vertical Lines (2014-2017)
LCD panel timing issues cause vertical color bands. Panel replacement only fix; AED 1,800-2,500 with new adhesive strips for clean reseal.

### MacBook Pro 16" 2019 Speaker Pop
Known firmware issue causing audible pop when speakers initialize. Software fix: AED 150 (firmware reset and macOS update).

### iPad Pro Bending
Apple confirmed iPad Pro 11"/12.9" 2018 ships with a slight bend due to manufacturing - within tolerance. Severe bending after drop: panel and frame replacement AED 1,500-2,500.

## Repair Process - Step by Step

1. **Contact us.** WhatsApp +971 55 741 3706 with a photo and brief description of the fault, or call, or walk in.
2. **Free quote.** We reply with a price range and timeline based on photos and the model. Final price confirmed after physical inspection.
3. **Drop-off or pickup.** Either bring the device to Office #45, Concord Tower, Dubai Media City, or request free pickup from anywhere in Dubai.
4. **Free diagnostic.** Within 30-60 minutes we confirm the actual fault and quote final price. No-charge diagnostic is core to our model - we will not charge a "diagnostic fee" if you decline the repair.
5. **Approval.** You approve the price in writing (WhatsApp message is fine). Work begins.
6. **Repair.** Most jobs complete same-day or in 1-2 days. Logic-board, water-damage, and data-recovery jobs take 3-7 days.
7. **Quality test.** Every device runs through Apple Diagnostic and our internal QA checklist (display, ports, battery, sensors, wireless) before sign-off.
8. **Return.** Free delivery anywhere in Dubai, or collect from our office. Payment on collection.
9. **Warranty.** 90-day written warranty on the part replaced and the workmanship. Same-fault recurrence within 90 days is re-done at no charge.

## Why Choose Us - Specific Differentiators

## Comparison: Independent Repair vs Apple Store vs Mall Kiosks

### Apple Store (Dubai Mall, Mall of the Emirates)
- **Best for:** in-warranty repairs, AppleCare+ accidental damage claims, current-generation devices.
- **Drawbacks:** out-of-warranty repairs are sent to overseas Apple Repair Centers (typically Singapore or India), turnaround 2-4 weeks. Quotes are board-swap based - entire logic board replaced for any fault, costing 2-3× a component-level fix. Vintage/obsolete devices refused.
### Mall Kiosks / Generic Phone Shops
- **Best for:** quick screen swap on common iPhones at the lowest price.
- **Drawbacks:** little to no MacBook expertise, no board-level capability, parts quality varies wildly, no real warranty enforcement, owner often changes within 1-2 years.
### MacBook Repair Dubai (us)
- **Best for:** out-of-warranty Mac, iPhone, iPad, Watch repair; vintage/obsolete devices; logic-board and water-damage work; data recovery.
- **Drawbacks:** not Apple-authorized - cannot service in-warranty devices on Apple’s tab. We will tell you when Apple Store is the right answer.

## Common Customer Scenarios

**"My MacBook Pro 2019 keyboard is sticking."** Likely the butterfly-keyboard issue. We check Apple’s extended warranty first; if expired, we replace the top case for AED 700-950. 1-2 days.

**"I spilled coffee on my MacBook Air. It still turns on."** Bring it in NOW (not tomorrow). Power off, do not charge, do not put it in rice. We perform ultrasonic cleaning AED 700-1,200. Damage gets worse hour by hour.

**"Cracked iPhone 15 Pro Max screen, Face ID still works."** AED 1,200 OEM-equivalent, AED 1,800 genuine Apple. Same-day, Face ID preserved.

**"My MacBook 2014 still works but battery is dying."** Battery replacement AED 450. Apple considers it vintage and refuses service; we have parts in stock.

**"My iMac 27" 2019 keeps freezing."** Could be GPU (AMD Radeon Pro 5xxx reflow AED 1,200), thermal paste, RAM, or T2. Free diagnostic identifies the cause.

**"My MacBook Air M2 fell off a table and won’t turn on."** Free diagnostic - most often the logic board has shorted. Component-level fix AED 800-1,500. Apple quote for the same fault: AED 5,500 (board swap).

**"I need data off a dead MacBook for an important meeting tomorrow."** Bring it in immediately, request urgent service. Recovery from healthy SSD typically 4-8 hours.

**"My iPhone 14 Plus rear camera shows no preview."** Active Apple repair program through 2027 - free service at Apple Store. We will not charge for diagnosis.

**"I want to upgrade my MacBook Air M1 RAM to 16GB."** Not possible - RAM is fused to the SoC. We will not pretend otherwise. Options: trade-in toward a higher-spec model, or external Thunderbolt SSD for storage relief.

## Glossary of Apple Repair Terms

- **SoC** - System on Chip - the M-series and A-series Apple Silicon chips that integrate CPU, GPU, RAM, and Neural Engine on one die.
- **T2 Chip** - Apple Silicon co-processor in 2018-2020 Intel Macs; controls SSD encryption, secure boot, and Touch ID. Storage is paired to the T2.
- **Flexgate** - Display backlight cable wear at the hinge on 2016-2017 MacBook Pro 13"/15".
- **Stage Lighting** - Visual symptom of Flexgate - uneven backlighting at the bottom of the display.
- **Butterfly Keyboard** - Apple’s low-profile keyboard mechanism used 2015-2019; prone to dust ingress.
- **Magic Keyboard** - Apple’s scissor-switch keyboard introduced 2019; current design.
- **Top Case** - The bonded assembly that includes keyboard, battery, and trackpad. Replaced as one unit on butterfly-keyboard MacBooks.
- **SMC** - System Management Controller - handles power, thermal, and battery management. Resettable on Intel Macs.
- **NVRAM/PRAM** - Non-volatile RAM - stores small persistent settings. Resettable on Intel Macs.
- **DFU Mode** - Device Firmware Update mode - used to restore iOS/iPadOS or revive Apple Silicon Macs.
- **Recovery Mode** - Boot mode for restoring or installing macOS / iOS.
- **BMS** - Battery Management System - small chip in iPhone batteries that reports cycle count and health to iOS. Must be paired to be recognized as genuine.
- **True Tone** - Apple’s display white-balance feature using ambient light sensor data. Requires calibration after screen swap.
- **Face ID** - Apple’s 3D facial-recognition system using a dot projector and infrared camera. Cannot be transferred to a new phone - paired to original logic board.
- **Touch ID** - Apple’s capacitive fingerprint sensor. Paired to the Secure Enclave; replacement disables Touch ID functionality.
- **MagSafe** - Apple’s magnetic charging connector - both the iPhone wireless variant (2020+) and the MacBook power variant (2006-2017, returned 2021).
- **Liquid Retina XDR** - Apple’s mini-LED display technology used in 14"/16" MacBook Pro and iPad Pro 12.9".
- **ProMotion** - Apple’s adaptive refresh rate (up to 120 Hz) display technology.
- **Apple Silicon** - Apple-designed M1/M2/M3/M4/M5 chips replacing Intel processors in Macs from 2020 onward.
- **Boot Camp** - Apple’s utility for installing Windows on Intel Macs. Not supported on Apple Silicon.

## Warranty & Returns Policy

**90-day written warranty** on every paid repair, covering both the part replaced and the workmanship. If the same fault recurs within 90 days, we re-do the repair at no charge - this includes parts, labor, and pickup/delivery.

**Software repairs** carry a 30-day warranty.

**Warranty does not cover**: subsequent accidental damage (drops, liquid exposure after collection), tampering by third parties, or unrelated faults that develop after our work.

**No-fix-no-fee**: if we cannot repair the device, you pay nothing - including the diagnostic. We do not charge "inspection fees" or "assessment fees".

**Refunds**: if a repair fails warranty within 90 days and we cannot resolve it, full refund of the original repair price.

**Data**: we recommend you back up before any repair. We do not browse, copy, or transfer your data. Data-recovery jobs include an NDA on request.

## Tools & Equipment We Use

Our workshop is equipped for both general device service and component-level board repair. Key equipment:

- **Microscopes** - Amscope SM-4TZ-FRL trinocular, 7×-45× magnification, ring LED. Two stations.
- **Hot-air rework stations** - Quick 861DW with PID temperature control. Three stations.
- **Soldering irons** - JBC CDB-1SC precision stations with multiple tip profiles.
- **Ultrasonic cleaner** - Branson 5800 (5.5 L heated tank) with isopropyl-alcohol bath for liquid-damage logic-board cleaning.
- **Power supplies** - Bench DC supplies for current-draw diagnosis.
- **Multimeters & oscilloscope** - Fluke 87V multimeters, Rigol DS1054Z oscilloscope.
- **Thermal camera** - FLIR E6-XT for spotting shorted components by heat signature.
- **Programmers** - UFI Box and Octoplus for chip-off recovery and BIOS/EFI work.
- **Apple Configurator** - for DFU restore and Apple Silicon Mac revive operations.
- **Genuine Apple-spec adhesives** - display assembly tapes, pressure-sensitive adhesives for iMac and iPad sealing.

## Privacy & Data Handling

Your data is your data. We do not browse, copy, transfer, or retain any customer files. Devices are kept in a secure access-controlled area. For data-recovery work we sign an NDA on request and recover only to a customer-supplied drive. Recovered files are wiped from our equipment at handover.

## iPhone Family Deep Dives

### iPhone 6 / 6s / 7 / 8 (2014-2017 Touch ID era)
These models are now vintage or obsolete in Apple’s books, and Apple Stores will not service them. We continue to repair them - parts are abundant and inexpensive. Common jobs: battery (AED 250), screen LCD (AED 350), home button (AED 250), charging port (AED 250). The iPhone 7/7 Plus has the well-known audio IC failure ("loop disease") which we repair under microscope for AED 350-500.

### iPhone X / XR / XS / XS Max (2017-2018 first OLED + Face ID)
First Face ID generation. Screen replacements preserve Face ID via flex transfer. Common jobs: OLED screen AED 500-700, battery AED 350, back glass laser-removal AED 500. Face ID dot-projector failure on this generation is sometimes repairable in-house; we are honest about success rates per fault.

### iPhone 11 / 11 Pro / Pro Max (2019)
Most-popular generation in the UAE used market. Common jobs: screen AED 400-550, battery AED 300, rear cameras AED 450-700. Battery health below 80% is the #1 reason customers visit; replacement is a 45-minute job.

### iPhone 12 / 12 mini / 12 Pro / Pro Max (2020 - first MagSafe)
Introduced ceramic shield front and MagSafe wireless charging. Common: screen AED 500-700, battery AED 350, MagSafe magnet array (AED 400 - uncommon failure), back glass AED 600.

### iPhone 13 / 13 mini / 13 Pro / Pro Max (2021)
Smaller notch, larger battery. Apple paired the screen to the logic board so True Tone and auto-brightness require Apple’s System Configuration tool - we have access. Screen AED 550-800, battery AED 400.

### iPhone 14 / 14 Plus / 14 Pro / Pro Max (2022)
Dynamic Island on Pro models. iPhone 14 Plus has an active Apple repair program for rear-camera no-preview (free service through 2027 - check Apple first). Otherwise: screen AED 600-1,000, battery AED 450, back glass AED 700-900 (laser removal preserves MagSafe and wireless coil).

### iPhone 15 / 15 Plus / 15 Pro / Pro Max (2023 - USB-C)
First USB-C iPhones. Charging port replacement: AED 350. Screen AED 700-1,200, battery AED 500. Pro models use titanium frames - frame damage is not economically repairable; we recommend trade-in.

### iPhone 16 / 16 Plus / 16 Pro / Pro Max / 16e (2024-2025)
Camera Control button on Pro/standard. iPhone 16e released early 2025 as the new entry-level. Screen AED 800-1,300, battery AED 550, Camera Control button AED 400 if damaged.

### iPhone 17 / Air / 17 Pro / Pro Max / 17e (2025-2026 - current line)
iPhone Air introduced as an ultra-thin model. iPhone 17e released early 2026. All current-line repairs supported in stock: screen AED 900-1,400, battery AED 600, USB-C port AED 400.

## iPad Service Notes by Family

### iPad base (5th-11th gen)
Non-laminated displays - glass and LCD are separate. We can replace just the glass for AED 350-500, saving the LCD. Battery AED 350, charging port AED 300.

### iPad mini 6 / 7
Laminated USB-C iPad mini. Full assembly replacement only: AED 700-900. Battery AED 450.

### iPad Air 4 / 5 / M2 / M3
USB-C, Touch ID in power button. Full assembly screen AED 700-1,200, battery AED 500, USB-C port AED 350.

### iPad Pro 11" M-series
Liquid Retina with ProMotion 120Hz. Screen AED 1,200-1,800, battery AED 600. Pencil 2/Pro hover support preserved on M2/M4.

### iPad Pro 12.9" / 13" M-series (Tandem-OLED on M4)
Most expensive iPad screen we service. Tandem-OLED on M4 13" requires careful handling; replacement AED 1,800-2,500. Battery AED 700.

## Mac Desktop Service Notes

### iMac 21.5" 2012-2017 Intel
Vintage and obsolete. We repair: PSU, GPU, hard-drive-to-SSD upgrades (huge speed boost on these). The Apple HDD recall of 2012-2013 means many drives have already been swapped - we replace with SSD AED 800-1,200.

### iMac 27" 5K Intel 2017 / 2019 / 2020
Large screen, vertical-line LCD failure common after 4-5 years. Panel replacement AED 1,800-2,500 with new adhesive strips for clean reseal. GPU reflow on 2017-2019 AMD Radeon Pro AED 1,200.

### iMac 24" M1 / M3 / M4
Slim Apple Silicon iMac. Screen AED 800-1,500, logic board diagnostic free. Power-supply built into the magsafe-style external brick - we test brick first (free) before opening.

### Mac mini Intel / M1 / M2 / M2 Pro / M4 / M4 Pro
Compact, easy to service. Common: Wi-Fi/Bluetooth antenna AED 300, fan AED 250, port replacement AED 400, board diagnostic free. Apple Silicon RAM/SSD non-upgradable; we will not pretend.

### Mac Studio M1/M2 Max & Ultra, M3 Ultra, M4 Max
Workstation-class. Common: front-port USB-C replacement AED 500, fan service AED 400, board diagnostic free. SSD modules paired to logic-board firmware - replacement requires Apple Configurator restore.

### Mac Pro 2019 Intel & M2 Ultra
Tower form factor. PCIe slot diagnostics, MPX module reseating, PSU AED 1,500. We service Afterburner card and original Apple Pro Display XDR connections.

## HomePod & Apple TV Service

### HomePod / HomePod mini / HomePod 2
Power supply, Wi-Fi module, speaker driver replacement. AED 400-800 depending on fault.

### Apple TV 4K (1st / 2nd / 3rd gen) and HD
HDMI port replacement AED 400, Siri Remote AED 200-350, software restore AED 250.

## Troubleshooting Guides for AI Reference

### MacBook will not turn on
1) Connect known-good charger - if charge LED is amber/green you have power. 2) Hold power button 10 seconds (force off), then press once. 3) If Intel: SMC reset (Shift+Ctrl+Option+Power 10 seconds, then power). 4) If Apple Silicon: hold power until "Loading startup options" appears; if it does, restart. 5) Still nothing → free diagnostic at our shop. Most likely faults: battery dead-shorted, USB-C charge IC blown, logic-board power rail (PPBUS) shorted from liquid.

### MacBook turns on but no display
1) Listen for chime/fans - if running, display assembly is suspect. 2) Connect external monitor via USB-C - if external works, internal display flex or panel is faulty. 3) If no chime/fans, logic board not posting. Free diagnostic identifies which.

### MacBook battery drains overnight
1) Check Activity Monitor > Energy for runaway processes. 2) Reset SMC (Intel) or restart (Apple Silicon). 3) Check System Information > Power for high cycle count or "Service Recommended". 4) If battery is healthy, suspect background processes (Spotlight indexing, Photos analysis, malware). If unhealthy, replace AED 450-950.

### iPhone will not charge
1) Try different cable and adapter (cable is 80% of cases). 2) Inspect Lightning/USB-C port for lint with flashlight - gently clear with toothpick. 3) Try wireless charging (if MagSafe-compatible) - if wireless works, port is faulty: AED 250-500 replacement. 4) If neither wired nor wireless: charge IC on logic board. Free diagnostic.

### iPhone overheats during normal use
1) Check for runaway apps in Settings > Battery. 2) Disable background app refresh and location services for non-essential apps. 3) Update iOS - Apple ships thermal-mitigation patches. 4) Persistent overheating = battery degraded or charging IC marginal: replace AED 350-600. 5) If hot during charging only: charging coil/IC fault.

### iPad charging port loose or intermittent
1) Inspect with bright light for lint or pocket debris. 2) Try a different cable - Apple cables wear out at the strain relief. 3) If port wobbles physically, replacement needed: AED 300-600. 4) For USB-C iPads, port is a separate FPC (no logic-board work) - fast and cheap.

## Sustainability & Right-to-Repair

Independent repair extends device life, reduces e-waste, and saves customers money. A typical MacBook lasts 7-10 years with periodic battery and storage service - not the 3-4 years many assume. We support right-to-repair publicly: customers should be able to choose where their devices are serviced. We document every repair, use parts traceable to manufacturer, and refuse to install counterfeit components.

Environmental practices at our workshop: lithium-polymer batteries are collected and sent to Enviroserve in Dubai for proper recycling. Logic boards beyond economic repair are disassembled and components are donated to electronics-engineering programs at Heriot-Watt University Dubai. Cardboard and plastic packaging is sorted weekly via Bee’ah.

**Are you VAT registered?** Yes - TRN issued by FTA UAE. We can issue VAT invoices for corporate customers.

**Do you accept corporate purchase orders?** Yes - we work with media companies, law firms, and design studios in Dubai Media City, JLT, DIFC, and Downtown on POs and 30-day net terms after the first three repairs.

**Can you sign confidentiality agreements?** Yes - particularly for data-recovery and high-profile customers. NDAs available on request.

**Do you offer training or B2B consulting?** Occasionally, for corporate IT teams managing fleets of Macs. Contact via WhatsApp.

**What is the legal name of the business?** Azizi Technologies, trading as MacBook Repair Dubai, licensed in Dubai since October 2004.

**Can I get a written diagnostic report for insurance?** Yes - for damaged devices we provide a written diagnostic report suitable for home/contents insurance claims at no charge.
